d125ada86c301135.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سفنز التجارية عن مصمم جرافيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير الأفكار والمفاهيم الإبداعية لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة عبر الوسائل الجرافيكية، وتصميم المواد الإعلانية والتسويقية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مصمم الجرافيك مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام التي تدعم الأهداف التسويقية والإعلانية للمؤسسة. تشمل هذه المسؤوليات: تطوير الأفكار الإبداعية والمفاهيم لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة بوسائل الجرافيك. وضع المخططات العامة وتصميم الإنتاج للإعلانات والمجلات وتقارير الشركات وغيرها من وسائل الإعلام المنشورة. تصميم المواد الإعلانية والتسويقية بما يتناسب مع هوية الشركة. إعداد التصاميم الإبداعية لمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي والحملات الإعلانية. مراجعة التصاميم وتعديلها وفق الملاحظات والتوجيهات. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تصميم الجرافيك. القدرة على تطوير مفاهيم إبداعية وتحويلها إلى تصاميم بصرية فعالة. معرفة ببرامج التصميم الجرافيكي الأساسية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل مصمم الجرافيك ضمن فريق المؤسسة لدعم الأنشطة التجارية والتسويقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

d1884cc802d5cb9c.description: About the Role The Payments Operations Head at سيتي جروب السعودية - Citigroup Saudi Arabia is a senior management position responsible for leading and building the payments operations function from the ground up within the Saudi Arabia branch. This full-time role involves managing a team to ensure the seamless delivery of high-volume cash management and transaction services, supporting clients with account operations, fund movements, intra-day funds management, and compliance. Key Responsibilities Lead the establishment of Citi's Payments Operations function in Saudi Arabia, developing processing capability and infrastructure. Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to implement payment systems for new branch operations. Build and structure a local payments operations team, defining roles, workflows, and daily governance. Oversee the governance of outsourced service providers handling branch transaction activity. Manage daily payments and cash transaction processing across multiple teams, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Resolve complex, high-impact operational issues within the branch. Evaluate team performance and guide decisions on training, development, and hiring to build local capabilities. Assess operational risk in daily decision-making, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Citi internal policy. Manage client transaction reporting, including new product introductions, statement migrations, and legal disclaimers. Negotiate internally at senior levels and with external parties as required. Appropriately assess risk in business decisions, safeguarding Citigroup's reputation, clients, and assets by ensuring compliance with laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to policy, and applying sound ethical judgment. Qualifications and Experience 7-12 years of experience in payments operations or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage a Payments Operations or multiple teams. Comprehensive understanding of concepts and procedures within payments operations. Experience overseeing quality reviews, end results, budget, policy formulation, and planning. Work Environment and Benefits This role offers the opportunity to shape Citi's presence in Saudi Arabia, leading a new payments operations function with significant autonomy and the backing of a global organization. The position operates on a hybrid model, combining three days in the office with two days of remote work each week. Benefits include access to structured learning and development programs, wellbeing resources, and competitive compensation.

d1ccc00f05e936a0.description: About the Role DXC Technology is seeking an experienced professional for the Windows/Virtualization Associate Manager Infrastructure Services position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing enterprise infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership and mentorship to infrastructure support teams. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Windows Server and virtualization environments. Manage Active Directory, ADFS, Group Policy (GPO), DNS, and DHCP. Manage and optimize VMware ESXi, vSphere, vCenter, or Hyper-V environments. Automate patching, provisioning, monitoring, and compliance checks using PowerShell, Ansible, PowerCLI, SCCM, and WSUS. Optimize infrastructure performance and resource utilization through DRS and High Availability (HA). Lead disaster recovery, failover, and failback exercises for virtual workloads. Implement security baselines, system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and regulatory compliance. Lead root cause analysis and resolution of major infrastructure incidents. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to L1/L2 support engineers. Manage virtualization integration with storage, networking, and backup solutions. Maintain infrastructure documentation, CMDB integrity, operational runbooks, and virtual machine lifecycle management. Required Experience and Skills Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in relevant infrastructure roles. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in the following areas: Windows Server administration. VMware or Hyper-V virtualization. Infrastructure automation. Disaster recovery planning and execution. Security compliance implementation. Work Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

d1df058d0ae39fe5.description: Eram Talent is seeking a confident, persuasive, and legally astute Accounts Receivable & Legal Collections Specialist to join our team in Al-Khobar. You will take full ownership of collecting pending corporate service and administrative fees from our clients. The ideal candidate knows how to build strong rapport with client stakeholders while using firm negotiation and Saudi commercial law expertise to ensure timely payment recovery without jeopardizing long-term business relationships. Key Responsibilities Service & Admin Fee Collection: Proactively follow up on pending and overdue invoices for corporate service agreements, administrative fees, and ongoing operational charges via phone, email, and in-person client visits. Client Relationship & Rapport: Build strong, friendly, yet authoritative relationships with client HR, procurement, and finance departments to smoothly push invoices through their internal approval pipelines. Contract & Milestone Verification: Review client Master Service Agreements (MSAs), purchase orders, and contractual payment milestones to counter payment delays or unjustified deductions. Legal Escalation & Notices: Leverage strong knowledge of Saudi commercial regulations to draft formal demand letters, issue legal notices, and coordinate with external legal counsel or enforcement platforms (such as Najiz) for delinquent accounts. Dispute Resolution: Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies or contract-related disputes firmly, professionally, and diplomatically. AR Aging & Reporting: Maintain accurate accounts receivable aging reports, log all collection commitments, and provide weekly cash-collection forecasts to senior management. Location Preference: Candidates currently residing in the Eastern Province (Al-Khobar, Dammam, Dhahran, or Jubail) are strongly preferred. Experience: 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, or Legal Collections in Saudi Arabia—experience in manpower supply, corporate services, or B2B consulting is a strong advantage. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration. Legal Acumen: Strong working knowledge of Saudi commercial law, B2B contract enforcement, and debt-recovery procedures. Languages: Native/fluent proficiency in Arabic and English (spoken and written), including the ability to draft formal legal and commercial correspondence in both languages. Key Traits: Bold & Assertive: Comfortable chasing high-value invoices, pushing back on excuses, and holding decision-makers accountable. Socially Adept: High emotional intelligence with the ability to connect naturally with people, turning gatekeepers into allies to get invoices cleared faster. Detail-Oriented: Able to spot contract gaps or missing PO documentation before they become excuses for non-payment.

d128430fb3d792d8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع شركة بلدي للدواجن عن أمين مستودع فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، ويهدف إلى ضمان سير العمليات اللوجستية للمستودع بكفاءة ودقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الواردة إلى المستودع، ومطابقة كمياتها ومواصفاتها، وتخزينها بما يتناسب مع طبيعتها ويضمن حفظها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. تحديد وتأمين الأدوات والمستلزمات والأجهزة والمعدات الضرورية لضمان حسن سير العمل، وذلك بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. إعداد مذكرات استلام المعدات والأجهزة الفنية من الشركات المتخصصة. صرف الطلبات الواردة من الجهات المختصة بموجب المستندات النظامية، والعمل على تجهيز وشحن الأجهزة وقطع الغيار إلى الجهات الرسمية الطالبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال أمين مستودع أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات بدقة. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات التخزين والصرف. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المخزون. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد المستندات والتقارير. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مصنع شركة بلدي للدواجن بمدينة أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

d12a0d84cda36e8c.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is developing a landmark destination in the Kingdom, focused on entertainment, culture, and hospitality. The Hospitality Business Unit is responsible for a portfolio of hotel assets central to this vision. The company seeks experienced professionals to ensure these assets meet high standards of design quality, guest experience, and commercial performance. The Role of Director - Development - Hospitality As Director - Development - Hospitality, you will lead the complete development lifecycle of hospitality assets, from initial concept and business case through to final delivery. This full-time role involves shaping development strategy, guiding critical decisions, and ensuring assets provide distinctive guest experiences, strong commercial performance, and long-term value for both the individual asset and the broader destination. You will work with key stakeholders to ensure alignment, manage project complexity, and confirm that assets are commercially robust and consistent with Qiddiya’s vision and development objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead the strategic development of hospitality assets from early-stage briefing to delivery, handover, and operational readiness. Shape asset strategy, feasibility studies, and business plans to define positioning, guest experience, and value creation. Drive cross-functional alignment across strategy, asset management, design, delivery, and Operators to ensure seamless progression from development to operations. Ensure assets align with Qiddiya’s vision and quality benchmarks, delivering best-in-class design and guest experience. Provide strategic oversight of key asset decisions, including positioning, room mix, amenities, guest experience, and operational planning, to maximize differentiation and portfolio performance. Lead key asset validation milestones, such as mock-up room reviews and critical gateway decisions, balancing Operator, design, commercial, and delivery requirements. Proactively manage interfaces, risks, and opportunities across all development workstreams to protect value and maintain delivery momentum. Lead governance and executive reporting processes, clearly articulating asset strategy, development priorities, risks, and recommendations in key forums. Mentor, guide, and develop teams, embedding strong development capability and best-practice approaches across the portfolio. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in hospitality development. Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end development of hospitality assets. Experience in shaping development strategy and guiding critical project decisions. Proven track record in managing cross-functional alignment and stakeholder interfaces. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company. Application Process Candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role, Director - Development - Hospitality (Job ID: 50012007JA).

d1bed95176757551.description: About DataVolt DataVolt is a global leader in sustainable and innovative data center solutions, providing infrastructure for businesses worldwide to connect, collaborate, and grow. The company focuses on security, reliability, scalability, and sustainability to empower clients in achieving digital transformation. DataVolt operates in Riyadh, Dubai, California, Mumbai, and Tashkent, committed to shaping a sustainable digital future through innovation. The Role of Health & Safety Lead DataVolt is seeking a Health & Safety Lead to join its team in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the implementation of HSE requirements across projects and ensuring compliance with local regulations for construction projects. The Health & Safety Lead will provide essential advice and support on all HSE-related matters for construction activities. Key Responsibilities Lead the implementation of DataVolt HSE requirements across the project. Advise, support, and ensure compliance with local regulatory and other requirements for construction projects. Advise and support on all HSE-related matters for construction. Identify, develop, or source required HSE training for onsite employees. Work with the Project Director to ensure appointed EPC contractors implement and maintain HSE standards that meet or exceed DataVolt expectations. Ensure all accidents and incidents are reported, investigated, and recorded in a timely manner. Review work procedures to assign risk levels and evaluate established risk controls. Ensure High Risk Activities are effectively planned, controlled, and managed. Prepare weekly and monthly reports, review data integrity, and confirm the accuracy of weekly and monthly statistics. Carry out daily, weekly, and monthly HSE inspections for construction activities. Implement best practices and lessons learned across projects, based on previous experience, knowledge, and DataVolt requirements. Conduct periodic HSE audits as per DataVolt requirements. Conduct weekly and monthly HSE meetings with different stakeholders and maintain records. Develop HSE initiatives and campaigns. Perform contractor and supplier assessments where applicable. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in Health & Safety roles, particularly within construction projects. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working on-site to manage and oversee Health & Safety protocols for DataVolt projects.

d1d4264c1b368866.description: About the Role flyadeal is seeking a Senior Aviation Security Specialist to ensure compliance with national and international aviation security regulations. This full-time role involves implementing security measures outlined in the Aircraft Operator's Security Programme (AOSP) and maintaining robust security protocols across operations. Key Responsibilities Monitor the issuance of airport security permits and access permissions for flyadeal employees. Liaise with airport security departments on all security-related matters. Conduct internal and external security audits in accordance with AOSP requirements. Produce initial and final audit reports, including corrective actions and recommendations. Monitor and verify the implementation of corrective actions (CAPs). Review safety and security incident reports within the Safety and Security Reporting System. Conduct security investigations and prepare formal investigation reports. Participate in issuing, updating, and maintaining AOSP-related manuals, SOPs, and sections. Update and maintain the Aircraft Operator Security Program (AOSP) to ensure ongoing compliance with national and international security requirements. Ensure the implementation of approved security policies and procedures at flyadeal HQ and all stations. Conduct Security Risk Assessments for stations, routes, flights, and emerging threats. Prepare State Supplementary Procedures (SSP) for new destinations. Coordinate with airport security teams regarding security events and operational issues. Participate in the Crisis Management Program (CMP) and support emergency response efforts. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Aviation, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of experience in Aviation Security or a related field. Comprehensive understanding of the AOSP and its application in aviation security operations. Strong knowledge of GACA, ICAO, and other relevant aviation security regulations. Experience in conducting security audits and preparing detailed reports. Required Skills High attention to detail and ability to manage complex regulatory requirements. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively interact with internal and external stakeholders.

d1ea68e6b7932108.description: About Red Sea Global and Coastal Transportation Services Company Red Sea Global is seeking a Manager - Health Safety for its subsidiary, Coastal Transportation Services Company (CTSC), located in Saudi Arabia. CTSC provides transportation services at the Red Sea destination, focusing on innovative and sustainable solutions, including autonomous vehicles. This full-time role is for individuals eager to contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage the implementation of Health and Safety policies and procedures within Coastal Transportation Services Company. This involves ensuring alignment with Red Sea Global corporate standards, local regulations, and international requirements and best practices to support safe operations. Key Responsibilities Translate the Health and Safety strategy into operational business plans and monitor their execution to achieve functional objectives. Contribute to the preparation of the functional budget and monitor financial performance. Ensure effective implementation of RSG and CTSC H&S Management systems and requirements. Support the development and implementation of H&S Plans and emergency response plans. Review Health, Safety, and Environmental Plans, emergency response plans, and risk assessments. Provide technical advice and support to the operations team on all H&S matters. Assist in delivering H&S training and awareness programs. Contribute to the development of the Mobility operations legal register, ensuring compliance with local legislation. Conduct regular H&S inspections, audits, and meetings. Investigate accidents and incidents, recommend preventive actions, and ensure lessons learned are implemented and shared. Lead site evacuations during drills and real emergencies, documenting events and identifying improvement opportunities. Assist top management with site H&S requirements and ensure compliance. Participate in QHSE-related meetings. Establish safe workplace practices and promote a positive safety culture. Assist in developing and maintaining Mobility policies, procedures, and contingency plans. Prepare accurate and timely functional reports. Apply safety, quality, and environmental management policies and controls. Support the development of operational performance dashboards. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in H&S systems, processes, and practices. Support synergies across The Red Sea Project and AMAALA Projects. Provide support in reviewing guest feedback related to transport and tracking corrective actions. Engage and influence others using various communication methods. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 years of practical experience in occupational Health and Safety. Degree or Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety or a related field. Knowledge and ability to use management concepts and principles, including goal setting, planning, and execution. Experience working on major programs and projects, preferably with developers. IOSH, NEBOSH Qualified/Accreditations, H&S relevant training, and qualified as an internal auditor. Strong knowledge of relevant H&S principles. Ability to adhere to Company policies, procedures, guidelines, and work requirements. Knowledge of local regulatory H&S requirements. Good knowledge of transportation business techniques and the ability to recommend safe work practices. Ability to prepare and update H&S statistical tracking and trending data. Ability to carry out incident investigations and root cause analysis. Proficient in MS Office Applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Strong documentation skills. Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. Application Information Red Sea Global invites qualified candidates to apply for this role to contribute to shaping the future of transportation at its Red Sea destination.

d1da47ad71738859.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المواقف الوطنية لمشاريع مكة عن مراقب حركة مركبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى مراقبة حركة المركبات وتدوين كافة البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بها، بالإضافة إلى توضيح المسائل الناتجة عن القرارات والتعليمات الصادرة من الإدارة العليا، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية لمراقبة حركة المركبات، وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. المشاركة في تنظيم جداول مواعيد وصول ومغادرة المركبات حسب المسارات المحددة، ومراقبة مدى التزام السائقين بها. مراقبة الأعمال والعمليات المتعلقة بالمركبات، مثل تدوين محتوياتها عند مغادرة المحطات وحمولتها وأوزانها وأرقام سائقي المركبات، ووقت مباشرتهم العمل ونهايته، ومراقبة مدى الالتزام بكافة السياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. تدوين كافة التعليمات والأوامر والقرارات الصادرة في السجل الخاص بها، والعمل على إرسالها وتوضيحها للسائقين. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق السياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. مهارات جيدة في تدوين البيانات والمعلومات بدقة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الباحة، وتتطلب الالتزام بمراقبة حركة المركبات والعمل ضمن فريق لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة المواقف الوطنية لمشاريع مكة.

d1073ab849152660.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة تركي ناصر الموح عن فني دعم تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة للموظفين والعملاء لحل المشاكل المتعلقة بتقنية المعلومات، وتحديد الاحتياجات من الأدوات والمستلزمات، بالإضافة إلى توفير المعلومات الفنية اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم والمساعدة الفنية للموظفين والعملاء الذين يواجهون مشاكل في تقنية المعلومات، والرد على استفساراتهم بهدف حل المشاكل التقنية. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات المطلوبة لأعمال دعم الموظفين والعملاء وحل المشاكل، مع تحديد النواقص ورفعها للمعنيين لتأمينها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. توفير المعلومات الفنية الخاصة بأجهزة ونظم وبرامج تقنية المعلومات، والرجوع إلى أخصائيي تقنية المعلومات عند الحاجة لمشكلات معقدة. حفظ البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بكافة أعمال وعمليات الدعم الفني المقدمة، والعمل على تبويبها وترتيبها بالاستناد إلى الممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال دعم تقنية المعلومات. القدرة على تشخيص وحل المشكلات التقنية الأساسية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم الفني بفعالية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني دعم تقنية المعلومات بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المؤسسة في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على حل المشكلات وتقديم أفضل خدمة للموظفين والعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

d12a8cd92477e49e.description: About the Role Raytheon is seeking a Heavy Vehicle Maintenance Technician to support the sustainment of Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces (RSADF) systems. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on Organizational and Direct Support repairs for vehicles. The role requires adherence to Preventive Maintenance Checks and Services (PMCS) Maintenance Standards and established DM procedures, with additional duties as directed by the section officer under the approved TAA. Key Responsibilities Advise RSADF on all aspects of vehicle maintenance. Provide recommendations for parts acquisitions. Perform maintenance services on various tactical vehicles, including component replacement, diagnosis of mechanical and electrical issues, and troubleshooting of brakes, suspension, fuel, and engine problems, utilizing technical manuals (TMs) and available hardware/software tools. Assist the section officer in enforcing safety policies, procedures, and standards. Conduct maintenance on electrical generators and diesel engines, including repair/replacement of components and preventative maintenance. Execute refurbishment, repairs, and upgrades for heavy-duty wheeled vehicles, such as HEMTTs, trailers, and single/dual axle generator trailers. Apply protective coatings and touch-up paint to parts, assemblies, and finished products as needed. Perform Direct Maintenance (DM) on heavy and light military and commercial vehicles with automatic and manual transmissions. Maintain, repair, and overhaul double gear systems. Utilize transmission test devices for diagnosis and troubleshooting. Qualifications and Requirements An AA/AS degree or other 2-year post-high school training is typically required. A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience is essential, with a total experience range of 5-10 years. Basic job knowledge of transmission test devices, maintenance, repair, and overhaul is required. Ability to follow basic work routines and standards through on-the-job training (OJT). Demonstrated experience in the maintenance and repair of heavy-duty vehicles. General knowledge of maintenance workshop procedures. Proficiency in the English language, both spoken and written. Work Environment This position is a full-time role based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, supporting critical defense systems for the Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces.

d13808fc71263810.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Design Manager to lead and coordinate all design activities for a major mega-development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Manage consultants and design teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality design packages and technical documentation. d1a81fbbd1a61e5c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أوف برايس عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء من خلال بيع السلع والخدمات، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة عن المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة ودقيقة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة بكفاءة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة نقاط البيع (POS) ومعالجة المدفوعات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على بناء علاقات إيجابية مع العملاء. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الشركة المتعلقة بالمبيعات وخدمة العملاء. بيئة العمل ستكون جزءاً من فريق عمل في شركة أوف برايس بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، حيث تتاح الفرصة للعمل في بيئة مبيعات نشطة وموجهة نحو خدمة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

d174a97a2059ddaa.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global is seeking a Senior Manager - Finance to join its team. d18f8800c048373b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سوبريم الخليج لتقنية المعلومات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتدقيق الحسابات المصرفية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإجراءاتها. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد المستندات والتقارير. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة السجلات والوثائق المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولم يتم الكشف عنه في الوقت الحالي.

d19cb02f247a8c83.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اليمامة للأعمال التجارية والمقاولات عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الإدارة العليا من خلال تنفيذ المهام الإدارية اليومية، تنظيم المواعيد، وضمان سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الإداري. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، بالإضافة إلى إدارة البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقًا لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بطريقة منظمة تسهل عملية الرجوع إليها عند الحاجة. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، بالإضافة إلى طباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر للأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الإداري أو ما يعادله. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة البريد والمواعيد اليومية. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية (مثل Microsoft Office). المهارات الشخصية مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية قوية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في إنجاز المهام. القدرة على إدارة الوقت وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تدعم تحقيق الأهداف الإدارية للشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

d1c35acd05bebfdc.description: About Johnson & Johnson and the Cardiovascular Team At Johnson & Johnson, the focus is on healthcare innovation to prevent, treat, and cure complex diseases, aiming for smarter, less invasive treatments and personalized solutions. Leveraging expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, the company works across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions. The Cardiovascular team develops solutions for heart recovery, electrophysiology, and stroke, with a focus on elevating standards of care for stroke, heart failure, and atrial fibrillation (AFib) patients. Role Overview: Senior Clinical Specialist - Cardiovascular Johnson & Johnson is seeking a Senior Clinical Specialist - Cardiovascular to join the team in Riyadh or Jeddah, KSA. This full-time role involves providing expert clinical and technical support for electrophysiology systems and catheter equipment to medical professionals. The specialist will work to optimize product usage, identify sales opportunities, and foster strong customer relationships within an assigned geography. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide expert clinical product and technical assistance and training to physicians and EP Lab Staff on electrophysiology systems and catheter equipment (*, The CARTO® System and associated software modules and RF generator) during case procedures. Educate customers on all electrophysiology products to optimize effective usage through technical and clinical information and in-service training. Collaborate with peers to share best practices and enhance customer value. Utilize consultative selling techniques to identify potential sales opportunities within accounts. Create awareness of electrophysiology solutions and facilitate Territory Sales Manager (TM) contact with key decision-makers to drive incremental business. Maximize customer case support capability through proper planning and scheduling. Drive collaboration and maintain consistent communication across assigned responsibilities with local and support teams, as well as other internal and external partners. Develop and share best practices with KSA Field Sales and Service colleagues and internal partners. Develop and grow mutually beneficial customer relationships within and beyond the EP lab, including physicians, nurses, technicians, clinical and hospital administrators, and staff. Stay current on company product instructions for use (IFU), best practices, technical troubleshooting, relevant scientific clinical literature, and new product information. Prioritize and respond appropriately to requests in high-stress environments, maintaining composure and problem-solving focus. Engage in diagnostic dialogue with multiple internal and external business partners and stakeholders, formulating solutions based on input. Provide mentoring for new electrophysiology commercial team members as requested. Respond daily to requests by email and voicemail from customers, practitioners, and partners. Perform administrative work, including managing account documentation, compliance training requirements, expense reporting, and Company system input. Maintain Safe Fleet standards according to Company guidelines. Communicate business-related issues or opportunities to the next management level. Ensure personal and Company compliance with all Federal, State, local, and Company regulations, policies, and procedures. Qualifications and Requirements Ability to provide hands-on support to physicians and patients as needed. Availability for emergent patient care is required. Ability to travel 80%+ within the region is required. 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in either Riyadh or Jeddah, KSA, requiring significant travel within the assigned region to support clinical procedures and customer relationships.

d1c5588217c0939e.company_name: شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية
d1c5588217c0939e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مشاريع المستقبل للمقاولات العامة عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الامتثال التام. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة للمشاريع وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة وإصلاح المعدات لتقليل العوادم والمخلفات، والتأكد من سير العمليات وفقًا لمعايير الصحة والسلامة البيئية. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفقدية لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات لضمان اتباع معايير سلامة البيئة، وتقديم النصح والمشورة اللازمة في هذا الشأن. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع المقاولات أو المشاريع الهندسية. فهم عميق لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وتطبيقاتها في المشاريع الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم توصيات لتحسين الأداء البيئي والسلامة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الفعال وتقديم المشورة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والدقة في العمل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتكيف مع بيئات العمل المختلفة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب الوظيفة التفرغ التام (دوام كامل). الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين وذوي الخبرة للتقديم على هذا الدور للمساهمة في مشاريع الشركة وضمان أعلى معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة.

d1f0c194ae8e340c.description: About the Role Mondelēz International is seeking a Perfect Store (TT) Lead to join their team in Jeddah. This regular position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves leading the development and execution of Perfect Store strategies across key channels and customers in Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on driving best-in-class in-store execution, visibility, and merchandising standards, ensuring alignment with category and brand strategies to deliver sustainable sales growth and improved commercial performance. Role Context The Perfect Store (TT) Lead will translate shopper, category, and customer insights into actionable in-store solutions. This involves continuously improving execution standards and identifying opportunities to strengthen Mondelēz International’s presence and competitiveness across the retail landscape in Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement best-in-class in-store execution standards for primary shelf placement, secondary displays, and visibility solutions, aligned with brand and category strategies across various channels and retail environments. Manage the end-to-end process for in-store visibility and display initiatives, including development, planning, implementation, and evaluation, ensuring consistent execution and alignment with commercial priorities. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to develop effective display solutions, optimize merchandising standards, and ensure compliance with Mondelēz International’s harmonized display guidelines. Monitor and analyze Perfect Store KPIs, identify execution gaps and distribution opportunities, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in in-store execution, promotional effectiveness, shelf availability, product visibility, and overall retail standards through data-driven recommendations. Support commercial initiatives by partnering with Category Planning & Activation, Sales, and other stakeholders on fast-track projects, including analysis, calculations, prioritization, approvals, execution monitoring, and performance evaluation. Manage project delivery and budgets, ensuring effective project management, documentation, reporting, and budget utilization, while maintaining visibility of project progress, risks, and outcomes. Maintain a strong understanding of the Saudi retail landscape, customer dynamics, channel developments, shopper behavior, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and strengthen market position. Qualifications and Requirements Proven experience in developing and implementing in-store execution strategies, merchandising standards, and visibility initiatives. Strong understanding of the retail environment, specifically the Saudi Arabian market, including key channels, customers, promotional tactics, and execution processes. Experience working with Point of Buying (POB) agencies, merchandising partners, and retail auditing agencies. Demonstrated ability to develop business reports, KPI dashboards, and performance tracking tools, providing insights into channel, customer, and shopper performance. Strong analytical capabilities, commercial acumen, and the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations. Experience in project management, including managing multiple initiatives, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Category Planning & Activation, and external partners. Excellent problem-solving, planning, prioritization, and execution capabilities. A proactive mindset, innovation orientation, and strong drive for results.

d102166c055a9432.description: About the Role Samara is seeking an IT Product Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading the vision, delivery, enhancement, and lifecycle management of digital solutions, specifically Sixt’s IMS platform, applications, and integrations. The successful candidate will work with various stakeholders to design and deliver customer-centric mobility solutions. Role Purpose The IT Product Engineer is responsible for driving the transformation towards a full mobility service provider by overseeing the end-to-end product lifecycle of digital IMS solutions. This includes managing B2B/B2C platforms from ideation through launch and continuous improvement, ensuring innovative and scalable solutions. Key Responsibilities Manage the full product lifecycle of the digital IMS platform (B2B/B2C solutions), from ideation to launch and ongoing enhancement. Collaborate with business, operations, and technical teams to define product requirements, priorities, and roadmaps, focusing on user experience for clients and staff. Translate business strategies and customer needs into clear, actionable product backlogs, stories, and features. Drive requirement gathering, sprint planning, and acceptance criteria within an agile development environment. Ensure the successful and timely rollout of digital platforms, API integrations, telematics, and customer portals within budget. Ensure platform scalability, interoperability, and data compliance, including robust reporting, analytics, and real-time fleet management capabilities. Interface with external partners such as OEMs, technology vendors, and JV partners for system integrations and co-development initiatives. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for platform adoption, usage, uptime, and customer satisfaction, implementing iterative product enhancements based on data and feedback. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), change management, and training for user groups across various business units. Maintain comprehensive documentation and version control for all solution developments. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated strategic mindset with the ability to translate business needs into digital products. Strong communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional and external teams. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring equipment reliability and the integrity of process unit equipment through comprehensive inspection activities and the implementation of robust inspection procedures. Role Purpose and Scope The primary purpose of this position is to provide guidance and support for monitoring and controlling inspection activities. The Inspection Engineer will be involved in developing and implementing inspection procedures, ensuring equipment reliability, suggesting improvements, and establishing inspection schedules. The role requires a proactive approach to maintaining plant safety and integrity, with a focus on preventing unexpected failures and leaks. Key Responsibilities Implement approved departmental policies, processes, and procedures, ensuring adherence for controlled work execution. Analyze and review all inspection activities, providing recommendations for improvement. Perform inspection activities on process unit equipment, including piping, columns, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, boilers, and storage tanks. Conduct corrosion engineering, develop inspection plans, maintain/update equipment inspection records, and issue reports to enhance integrity. Inspect and review Quality Certificates for various equipment applications in accordance with international standards. Perform static equipment thickness calculation and evaluation, along with strength calculations for heaters, heat exchanger tubes, tanks, and vessel shells per API codes. Prepare annual inspection plans for piping and static equipment. Supervise inspectors and NDT technicians, review their reports, and evaluate performance. Prepare inspection scope for static equipment during normal maintenance and turnaround activities. Participate in shutdowns, issue recommendations for equipment and piping integrity, monitor implementation, and forecast material requirements for future shutdowns. Inspect and review reports for relief valve/pressure relief valve set pressure testing, thickness measurement, MPI, and RT. Develop inspection monitoring plans based on identified damage mechanisms and previous findings. Ensure compliance with company standards, repair procedures, and guidelines. Issue, review, and develop inspection procedures (*, piping inspection, NDT, welding) as per international standards and codes. Assess equipment status to provide assurance against unexpected failures by reviewing PHA/HAZOP reports and previous findings. Participate in incident investigations and failure analysis related to mechanical integrity of static equipment, identifying weaknesses and recommending long-term solutions. Provide on-job training to subordinates to enhance their skills in performing duties safely and efficiently. Evaluate contractors and provide recommendations. Maintain records of calibrations and tests, ensuring compliance with work instructions and plans. Ensure equipment downtime is within specified standards and contribute to procedure and maintenance instruction updates. Prepare accurate technical evaluation reports for the department. Ensure compliance with all relevant health, safety, security, and environmental procedures. Participate in safety, health, and environmental programs and incident investigations, providing technical expertise. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in inspection engineering. Strong understanding of international standards and codes (*, API). Proficiency in performing thickness calculations, strength evaluations, and developing inspection plans. Experience in supervising inspection teams and NDT technicians. Demonstrated ability to participate in shutdowns and incident investigations. Working Relationships The Inspection Engineer will collaborate internally with Operations, Project & Engineering, Warehouse, EHSS, Procurement, HR, and GS departments. External interactions will include existing and potential suppliers, vendors, and contractors as required. Decision-Making Framework This role operates within detailed standard practices and instructions. Work is subject to technical evaluations, requiring decisions to be made within established practices and procedures.

d1fc704d5bfbd8dc.description: About the Role Boutique Group is seeking a Credit Manager to join its team in Riyadh. Provide monthly reports of facts and figures to management. Uphold and embody the company’s legacy values and competencies in all interactions with teams and stakeholders, serving as a role model for the desired culture and behaviors. Experience Required 3-5 years of relevant experience. Internal Communications Management team and all colleagues within the hotel. Finance teams in other Strategic Business Units (SBUs). Group Finance & Regional Finance Teams. Internal Auditors. External Communications Finance service providers. Hotel suppliers. Asset Managers. External Auditors. d1990a52ac1b4139.description: Job description We are seeking an experienced Plant Tissue Culture Technician responsible for the laboratory-based propagation of rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, and high-value plant species using tissue culture and micropropagation techniques . Develop, refine, document, and standardise tissue culture protocols for priority plant species. Maintain detailed records covering explant sources, media formulations, culture dates, subcultures, treatments, contamination rates, multiplication rates, rooting success, and plant survival. Maintain laboratory inventories of culture media components, consumables, chemicals, glassware, and sterile materials.
